installation: Root-only --install-approved; separately approved companion SHA plus exact previous base package SHA, retained receipt-head SHA, ledger SHA and optional backup SHA. Resume original same-instance A installer without changing its strict ledger/history validators.
rollback: Root-only --rollback-approved; verify all new and base deletion targets, identities, hashes, members, limits, empty cgroup and complete receipt history before first unlink. Retain base ledger/receipts/backup and fault LOG/receipt/case logs.
failure: Preserve partially created paths for inspection; no automatic overwrite, retry or cleanup.
host_responsibility: Separate approved host helper verifies fixed VM, package, host ACL/profile/bridge and exact existing service GUID; DVD staging and restoration are host actions. Guest installer makes no host changes.
scope: Repository candidate only; no installation, VM/root configuration, protected 48/Gold data, real model/training, release, activation or qualification. New companion archive approval is independent of original A package approval.
